name: Soccerverse
storyline:
With hundreds of clubs competing against each other in leagues with weekly matches. Experience a classic real-time multiplayer soccer management game like never before.
Buy and sell shares in the clubs and receive dividends based on the team performance.
Vote in the hiring and firing of the club’s manager.
Get paid a weekly dividend from the club’s profits.
Buy the right players, play the right tactics and compete against other managers.
Like a real manager, you will need the backing of your club’s shareholders.
As a manager you will receive a wage from the club.
Look after your players and do what’s in their best interests for their careers.
You will need to have the support and trust of your player’s shareholders.
Get paid a weekly wage from each of your players’ salaries.
Depending upon a club’s performance, it can advance to a higher division, or be relegated to a lower division. Higher divisions are more profitable for shareholders and managers.
summary:
Know your players, Own your success

A persistent football universe running in parallel to the real-world game — active, social, competitive and shaped by its community.

Own a piece of football clubs and players, and receive payouts from matchday income. Scout wonderkids early and watch your stake grow as their careers take off.

Simple to start, deep enough to get lost in.
